tasks.title: Support same-epoch authoritative recovery after confirmed connectivity
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: A newly confirmed native control can request exactly one same-epoch retry on the existing queued Configuration owner after an offline failure, including an old read still draining. Ordinary cached behavior and root/session/epoch fencing remain intact; no new timer, owner or allocation.
tasks.validation: Focused completed-and-draining offline failure regressions, existing Configuration units and the WORK006 actual native reconnect fixture with a one-hour poll interval; all source/native/docs/review costs remain with WORK006.
